headline: A parent reference is a claim. Executed use is evidence.
description: Completed frozen research, separate from fresh browser computation. The primary flywheel retained no new asset: it beat the saved-workflow procedure, tied an equally enabled learner, and lost to the stronger fixed portfolio. The separate diagnostic built 12 typed lineages. All 12 fresh lookahead missions executed inherited dispatch, three qualified; no fresh repair both called its lookahead parent and qualified.

tables.title: Strong comparisons at the primary budget
tables.note: 12 paired streams, 1,000,000 declared work units per stream. Valid shows valid / attempted outputs. All 864 offered tasks stay in the qualification denominator. Paired flywheel-minus-workflow mean difference +4.33 missions per stream; 95% bootstrap interval [3.67, 4.92]. No new asset caused this difference.

tables.title: Equal qualified output at the larger budget
tables.note: At 2,000,000 units per stream, all arms complete their entire stream and qualify the same 668 tasks. The flywheel costs 16.10% more than the fixed portfolio. These are sensitivities on the same task set, not independent new samples.

tables.title: What inherited ancestry actually changes
tables.note: Separate correctness-only diagnostic, 5,000,000-unit ceiling, four missions per stream including the founder. Inheritance saves 60.35% against exact rebuilding; equivalent replacements preserve every fresh schedule. The cheaper parent-removed fallback qualifies one more mission. Typed lineage counts do not prove productive parent use: only four repair qualification outputs both invoke the parent and qualify, and zero fresh repairs do both. All inherited admissions fail the full-investment forecast.

native_reference.note: Established SciPy/HiGHS specialist, not a method discovered by the flywheel. Native time, main reference work and browser units are different measurements. Deadline feasibility is not optimal makespan.

interpretation: Twelve typed ancestry chains do not establish twelve fresh deep uses of a repair predecessor.
All twelve fresh lookahead missions invoke the retained dispatch parent; three qualify.
Four selected-repair qualification outputs qualify and invoke lookahead. They are qualification evidence, not the subsequent fresh repair missions.
Only one fresh repair invokes lookahead, and it fails qualification. Zero fresh repairs both qualify and invoke that parent.
The 86 aggregate repair-parent decisions include 44 calls by other or losing discovery candidates; aggregate research calls do not establish retained productive dependency.
Stream 10 has a descriptive fresh lookahead makespan improvement from 50 to 47 while both treatments qualify; all twelve paired outcomes are retained to avoid selecting only this favorable case.
data.independence_limits: Parent-call counters are producer instrumentation, independently attributed and summed here. Output validity and qualification are checked by the separate frozen checker. This review does not independently trace CPU execution or rerun parent-removal experiments. A recorded call proves neither that the parent was necessary nor that the full investment paid back.
